messages:
mike: Quick heads-up — we have a potential routing hiccup uncovered in staging that could affect a small set of tenants during the v2 cutover (03/22 02:00 UTC). posting details.

alex: ok what did you see?

mike: mobile SDKs sometimes send duplicate version headers with different casing/order; gateway treats headers order/case-sensitively and picks first seen. Example log: 

```
Api-Version: v1
X-Api-Version: 2
User-Agent: RedwoodMobile/1.2.3
```

If v1 header appears first client ends up routed to v1 even though SDK included v2 header. Could lead to confusing "stuck on v1" reports after cutover.

jen: long-term we should canonicalize headers (casefold + pick canonical key) in the gateway before routing. Small change but safer.

sara: agree, normalization is the right fix. Can we land it quickly?

alex: implementation estimate: ~30m dev + 15m deploy to edge-canary + 15m observation. So ~1h total to validate.

mike: scheduling-wise we have two choices given cutover in the window: 1) land gateway normalization before cutover (exposes a config change in critical path); 2) pin affected tenants to v1 for 24h so they don't get inadvertently routed to v2, and roll normalization after cutover. I'm leaning to option 2 for minimal blast radius.

ops-bot: Recommendation: automate pin via DeployBot so CS can easily tell customers and we can revert quickly.

mike: proposed command: `/deploybot pin-tenant tenant-a tenant-b kiosk-12 --duration 24h --reason "header quirk mitigation for v2 cutover"`

courtney: I'm oncall for the window and can watch the dashboards. Which tenants are impacted?

mike: telemetry shows anomalies for: tenant-a, tenant-b, kiosk-12. Low count but these include two high-SLA customers.

jen: rollback criteria draft for release notes: 
- sustained v2 5xx > 2% for >=10m
- top-tenants 4xx/5xx > 3x baseline for 5m
- header-routing-mismatch metric spikes > 10x baseline

alex: add quality-monitor: prompt-failure-rate > 2x baseline for 5m (signal for regressions).

mike: will include those in the ops checklist. Jen — can you schedule the normalization canary at +1h after cutover so we can unpin earlier if it's green?

jen: yes I'll push to edge-canary at +1h and run a 15m observation. If no routing mismatches during that window I'll post and we can unpin.

deploybot: Pin request acknowledged — pins applied to tenant-a, tenant-b, kiosk-12 at 7410001248 by mike. Duration: 24h.

courtney: dashboards I'll be watching: api-v2-5xx-rate, header-routing-mismatch, top-tenant-4xx, quality-monitor. I'll bump alert thresholds per rollback criteria.

mike: please also add a temporary note to release email + CS playbook: "If customers report behavior that looks like v1 after cutover, they may be temporarily pinned — ask them to upgrade SDK or contact support." Make it bold in the CS message.

sara: also post a short note in #support with pin list so frontline can triage quickly.

jen: pushing canary config to edge-canary at +1h after cutover; will report results here. If it fails we'll keep pins active.

mike: thanks. No objections — proceeding to apply pins and finalize release notes.

alex: infra ok.

courtney: monitoring ready, will page on threshold breach. :thumbsup:

mike: deploybot note: to unpin manually use `/deploybot unpin-tenant tenant-a` or wait for expiry.

mike: thanks everyone — I'll update the release doc with the exact tenant list and rollback criteria and ping when canary completes.
